name: WeCom Notifier
description: Push mail alerts to a WeCom group-robot webhook
author: MailFlow community
readme:
# WeCom Notifier

Registers the notifier component id `wecom`. Options: `webhook_url`, `timeout_seconds`. Sends a text message with the mail summary.
